notes.title: 80th Anniversary of the Victory of the World Anti Fascist War
notes.content: [p]Commemorating the 80th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti Fascist War is a series of activities held to commemorate the 80th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti Fascist War. The theme of the event is "Remembering history, honoring martyrs, cherishing peace, and creating the future".  [/p][p]On September 3, 1945, after 14 years of bloody battles, the Chinese people won the great victory of the War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and declared the complete victory of the World Anti Fascist War. Since then, September 3 has been remembered by the Chinese people as the anniversary of the victory of the War of Resistance against Japan. General Secretary Xi Jinping pointed out that the great spirit of the War of Resistance Against Japan is a precious spiritual wealth of the Chinese people, which will forever inspire them to overcome all difficulties and obstacles and strive for the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.[/p][p]2025 is the 80th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti Fascist War, and commemorations have been held all over the country. On March 7, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, said that China would solemnly commemorate the 80th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti Fascist War in 2025. On May 13, the State Council Information Office publicly released the logo for the commemoration of the 80th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti Fascist War. In June, photo exhibition and other commemorative activities were held to commemorate the 80th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti Fascist War. On the morning of September 3, a grand conference was held in Beijing Tiananmen Square to commemorate the 80th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti Fascist War, including a review of troops.   Live broadcasts will be conducted on the television channels affiliated with China Central Radio and Television Station.  [/p][p]China solemnly commemorates the 80th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression, highlights the great contribution of the Chinese nation to the victory of the world anti fascist war, and joins hands with peace loving countries and people to remember history, remember the martyrs, cherish peace, and create the future.[/p][p]As a Chinese game studio, Mallet Games warmly celebrates the 80th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti Fascist War. We believe that justice, peace and the people will win![/p][p]Long live the People's Republic of China, long live the great unity of the people of the world![/p]

notes.title: Remembering the turbulent years in the name of the game | Doomsday 1.0.3 version
notes.content: [p]Dear players:[/p][p]On the 80th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War, we, with profound respect and gratitude for history, not only pay tribute to our predecessors through special events but also bring players a refreshed gaming experience through the comprehensive upgrade of "Doomsday" version 1.0.3. This update focuses on technical optimization, gameplay enrichment, and meticulous refinement, enabling every survivor to write their own legendary chapter in the post-apocalyptic world.[/p][p][b]I. Remembering History and Cherishing Peace[/b][/p][p]Our decision to launch the version update on September 3rd stems from our profound reverence for national memory. The resilient figures who stood firm amidst war and the resounding cries of freedom fighters have become indelible imprints on the spiritual landscape of the Chinese nation. While "Doomsday" is a survival-shooting game set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, its core narrative consistently resonates with humanity's resilience and unity during crises. Through this approach, we aim to let the younger generation feel history's pulse through digital entertainment and understand the preciousness of peace.[/p][p][b]II. VERSION UPDATIONS[/b][/p][p align="justify"]l The animation in the first person perspective is improved and the action is more delicate.[/p][p align="justify"] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44295590/e8aebef88b97cd0fd1d7f3e79d8473ee69d182ee.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"]l The layered performance of character animation in the third person perspective is optimized, and the transition is more natural.[/p][p align="justify"]l Fixed the problem of enemy corpse collision detection and reduced the phenomenon of wearing the mold.[/p][p align="justify"] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44295590/9da21cea407e9f76386c99185240cd4ca778603e.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"]l The new V1.0.3 version of vehicle explosion, blood and tire damage effects are added to enhance the sense of immersion and improve the balance of the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44295590/ad437fe8f234cb8e20f4dc1afb5d594b855cd2b5.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"]l The problem of sound attenuation has been fixed to make the sound effect more real and natural.[/p][p align="justify"]l The synchronization problem of camera shake when hitting the target is corrected to improve the experience of striking.[/p][p align="justify"]l The synchronization problem of blocking camera shake is solved to make the game picture more smooth.[/p][p align="justify"]l The display effect of the fishing interface has been improved and the operation is more intuitive[/p][p align="justify"]l Two new weapons: UZI submachine guns and revolver pistols.[/p][p align="justify"]l Add single bullet loading function to adapt to different combat needs.[/p][p align="justify"]l The AI perception system was fixed and the enemy behavior became more intelligent.[/p][p align="justify"]l The character's leaning motion in the third person perspective is improved to increase tactical options.[/p][p align="justify"]l The reverse dynamics animation of the hand is optimized to enhance the authenticity of the gun holding action.[/p][p align="justify"] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44295590/0898f815f4498727f8b96f54a80cd4eefb8c11a3.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"]l Correct the synchronization problem of squatting action, and the multiplayer game experience is better.[/p][p align="justify"]l The rendering boundary of the role is adjusted to avoid model misalignment or disappearance.[/p][p align="justify"]l Fix problems related to facial expressions and make interactions more expressive.[/p][p align="justify"]l The overall quality of the animation in the third person perspective has been improved.[/p][p align="justify"]l New version 1.0.3 furnace and smelting mechanics to enrich the survival gameplay.[/p][p align="justify"]l The new and improved ladder climbing system is more mobile and can climb high places for sniper fire.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44295590/268cf49c8fe6ffdcf46ebcc06f20bc6949bc82d9.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"]l Upgrade the front sight system for more accurate aiming.[/p][p align="justify"]l Added a safety zone mechanism, strategic planning is more important, players in the safety zone will not be hurt.[/p][p align="justify"]l Added the no-aim throw function to provide more tactical options.[/p][p align="justify"]l Add new sound effects and visual effects from version 1.0.3.[/p][p align="justify"]l New UI design, more beautiful interface.[/p][p align="justify"] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44295590/f1f6b0cfb4c0d16818754d33bf9a3e18e9c21cd3.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"]l Fixed projectile collision detection problem, physics effect is more accurate.[/p][p align="justify"]l Corrected the collision detection problem of projectiles, and the operation feedback is more realistic.[/p][p align="justify"]l Added multiple map switching, players can choose their own map to play, more user-friendly.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44295590/528dba5905d8fbd56b8862b17adc726fcdffa70c.png"][/img][/p][p]l Added the Bodycam effect, which can be adjusted in the Settings. Remember, it only works after restarting the game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44295590/744e532a5071c9d49ca716c4de897b1420d3d349.png"][/img][/p][p]l Added two achievements (changing outfits, voice chat)[/p][p][b]III. ON DOOMSDAY[/b][/p][p]As a hardcore survival game, "Doomsday" masterfully blends strategic planning, resource management, and real-time combat. Players must establish shelters, gather supplies, and fend off zombie invasions in a perilous post-apocalyptic world, overcoming challenges through tactical brilliance. Featuring advanced physics engines for realistic combat feedback and a versatile weapon customization system, the game offers each survivor a unique path to growth.[/p][p]At the same time, I would like to thank Dreamrise Sdudio for providing such a good platform for us to develop games more quickly![/p][p][b]IV. Feedback on the Day of Remembrance[/b][/p][p]To commemorate the profound significance of the World Anti-Fascist War, a special lottery event will be launched on the Little Black Box platform starting today, distributing over 930+19 activation codes for the game "Doomsday". The number 930 corresponds to September 3rd, the Victory Day of the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression, while the 19 codes represent the 19 days and nights the Mallet Games team spent working on this version update. This is not only a game gift but also a declaration of peace protection in the digital era.[/p][p][/p][p]Please follow [url="https://www.xiaoheihe.cn/app/user/profile/70502873"]Mallet Games on the official account of HEY Box[/url]. After following, you can see the lottery post. Reply to the lottery post, and you can participate in the lottery. There are not many places, first come, first served.[/p][p][/p][p]Box friends who get the serial number can enter the [url="https://store.malletgames.cn/"]official store[/url] and enter the coupon to get the serial number for free![/p][p][url="https://www.xiaoheihe.cn/app/bbs/link/163234135"]Join the event link[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44295590/f5fcf56a812331d4c4c05c028c4d421d2ca92eda.png"][/img] [/p][p][b]V. Resonance between Game and Reality[/b][/p][p]When you command your team to hold the position in the game, we learn teamwork; when you carefully allocate limited resources, you also experience the hardships of wartime scarcity. These designs are not coincidental—— We always believe that great games do more than just bring joy—they serve as cultural bridges connecting the past and the future.[/p][p][b]VI. Contacting us[/b][/p][p]If you encounter technical problems or have suggestions, please feel free to contact us through email malletgames@malletgames.cn![/p][p][b]VII.Off topic remarks[/b][/p][p]Mallet Games has been committed to creating better games since its establishment on December 20, 2022. At present, we have just finished the middle school entrance examination and are about to enter the gate of high school. Our studies are even more demanding, and the game updates will be slow in the future. We hope for your understanding. But we hope that through our efforts, our works will definitely become even better![/p]

notes.title: Solution for players who cannot download the game on the early "Doomsday" test
notes.content: [p]Dear players, hello. Since the launch of 'Doomsday', we have received enthusiastic support from players around the world. Thank you for choosing Mallet Games. Recently, we have noticed that some players have raised the issue of the game not being able to download.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44295590/0b63ac62f3d081c22b44ed101eaf523aa688a500.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As shown in the picture. After discussion, we have roughly determined that it is due to an empty game package that resulted in a download size of 0KB. This issue may have been troubling players for a long time, and we sincerely apologize for it. [/p][p][/p][p]Mallet Games is a game development studio composed of high school students. We participated in the middle school entrance examination in June this year, which was very important to us, so it delayed the operation of the game. Fortunately, we achieved good results. [/p][p][/p][p]During the internal testing of the game, we issued a test specific CDkey, and we appreciate the players who supported us at that time. Now that the game has been officially released and beta testing has ended, it cannot be played. [/p][p][/p][p]Our solution: Please contact our email address [i][u]malletgames@malletgames.cn [/u][/i]and provide a screenshot of your game in your game library that cannot be downloaded. We will immediately send the serial number. We will assist beta players in upgrading to the official version of the game for free. Please also provide your name, and we will include you in the 'Community Player' list. Thank you for your cooperation![/p]

notes.title: Regarding the issue of lost game files and its solutions
notes.content: [p]Firstly, we apologize to all players for our negligence.[/p][p]When Doomsday was first released on the Steam platform, it was in a free state. Players who entered Doomsday during the free state (Or use the beta version CDK) may not be able to download game files properly in the updates after switching to a paid version. We originally wanted to operate the game for free, but we didn't understand the operating mechanism of the Steam platform, which led to the mistake of switching to paid. So we set the game price at the lowest possible price, hoping to make up for this mistake to some extent. However, this mistake indirectly led to the problem of not being able to download game files, and we deeply apologize. So we propose the following possible solutions:[/p][olist][*][p]Purchase 'Apocalypse'[/p][/*][*][p]Contact the developer (email: malletgames@malletgames.cn ）[/p][/*][*][p]If you can provide evidence (such as screenshots) that you have played "Apocalypse" before and are unable to download it properly, please contact the email address above. We can assist you in resolving the issue. Due to busy academic schedules, we may not respond in real-time. We hope for your understanding.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Once again, we apologize to all players for our mistake, which has caused a bad experience for many players. We will study the operating rules of the Steam platform seriously. Finally, we hope that players can forgive our mistakes.[/p]

notes.title: Announcement of the release of the new version of the game 'Doomsday'
notes.content:
Hello dear players!
We are excited to announce that the game 'Doomsday' is about to receive a new version update. Although this update did not include the planned new maps, many new features and optimizations will bring you a completely refreshed gaming experience.
1、 Update Highlights List
1. Anti cheating update
In order to create a fair gaming environment, we have strengthened our anti cheating system to ensure that every player can play smoothly in a fair competitive environment.
2. In game voice
New in-game voice function has been added to facilitate communication and collaboration among players, making team battles closer.
3. Vehicle system
A brand new vehicle system has been launched, allowing players to drive various vehicles and gallop in the apocalypse, increasing the exploration fun and strategic nature of the game.
4. Chinese support
Comprehensively optimize the Chinese interface and subtitles, so that you no longer have to worry about language barriers during the game process.
5. Beginner's Tutorial
Carefully designed beginner tutorials to help new players quickly get started and embark on a journey of post apocalyptic survival.
6. Achievement System
Rich achievement system, record your glorious moments in the game, unlock more honors and rewards.
7. Female roles
Add female characters for players to choose from, and diverse character settings make the game world more colorful.
8. Add shortcut keys
Optimize the operation experience, add shortcut key settings, making your operations more convenient and smooth in battles.
2、 Update time
This update will be officially launched on February 2, 2025. At that time, you can log in to the game and personally experience the surprises brought by these new contents.
Thank you for your continuous support and love for the game 'Apocalypse'. We will continue to work hard to bring you more exciting game updates and high-quality gaming experiences. If you encounter any problems or have any suggestions during the game, please feel free to contact us through the official forum (forum. mailetgames. cn) at any time.
May you have a pleasant journey in the world of'Doomsday'!
'Doomsday' Operations Team
February 2nd, 2025

notes.title: 关于游戏的发布
notes.content:
由于最近在写暑假作业，没去管理steam上的事情，于是上交了游戏的审核就没在管，在此期间steam直接将《末日》发布了，然而我并不知情。说实话我当时感觉挺突然的，还有玩家给我的游戏写了很长的测评，我也认真去看了，指出的问题我也都记在了小本本上，我保证会修改的，感谢大家的支持。

目前游戏的联机模式有问题，会一直卡在加载界面。如果您卡在了单人模式的加载界面，可以尝试加速steam或调低画质来进行游戏（不保证解决100%此类问题，因为这类问题在内部测试时没有出现）。

因为这次突然地发布，很多bug还没有修改，对玩家的游戏体验带来了很大的影响，我向玩家们道歉。
我们会继续对游戏进行打磨，我们接下来的目标是:

1.修改地图设计，目前的地图交战密度过大，我们将修改地图设计，增加地图种类。

2.优化音效，目前游戏内枪声并不能渲染出良好的末日感

3.优化动画，由于人机骨骼重定向和布娃娃的问题，人机动画和死亡布娃娃显得很肌无力

4.修复若干已知bug（如人物会在特殊地方卡住等）

5.开始剧情模式的开发

综上，我们的游戏还有很多的问题，我们会尽力给支持我们的玩家最好的游戏体验
——大锤工作室
